findings.text: the glossary clause "reviewed is the number of rows the review medians are taken over" is not what the mechanism computes: the deliverable (line 221) counts reviewed from the existing reviews list, which the scan fills only for rows with a numeric review.total (reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:371-374), while a row whose review is missing a dimension is still added to that dimension's list yet carries no total because the parser withholds it (reckon/crew/review.py:774,782) — so Jev would read each dimension's median over more rows than reviewed states, which is the opposite of the sample-size reading the section exists to give ("lets Jev tell a median over two rows from one over eleven"); the fixture hides this because its fourth row (line 235) pairs a missing reuse with a present total 86, an input the parser never emits
